blurb: Guests start with tandem immersion jumps, learning basic canopy controls and parachute deployment with instructor backup. They progress through ground school, emergency procedures, and solo canopy flights guided by radio. The AFF program follows USPA Categories B-F, requiring skill demonstration before advancing and completion of jumps within 30 days.
extraNote: Once past CAT-B, no refund eligibility except for extraordinary issues at management discretion

quotes.author: Chris
quotes.text: Amazing place! Really great people who may you feel welcome the second you arrive! I would rate higher than a five if I could.

quotes.author: Stephanie
quotes.text: This place separates the doers and the talkers. Only doers survive here. It was amazing! Mikey, my tandem partner was awesome.

quotes.author: Jeremy
quotes.text: Fantastic experience from start to finish. Today was my first of many jumps! Highly recommend this place!
